name: rstudy-saas-assets
description: Solo build degli asset statici (CSS e icone) per saas/app/static/dist. Non è codice eseguito dal server.

config.icons: layout-dashboard menu sun moon graduation-cap log-out log-in user-plus plus search pencil trash-2 calendar-clock list-checks target circle circle-check book-open save sparkles layers copy notebook-pen arrow-right cloud credit-card settings download upload gauge user

scripts.build:icons: mkdir -p app/static/dist/icons && for i in $npm_package_config_icons; do cp node_modules/lucide-static/icons/$i.svg app/static/dist/icons/; done
scripts.build: npm run build:icons && npm run build:css
